definition: Automatically selecting the most aesthetically pleasing or informative crop of an image, using saliency and composition models.
details: Automatically selecting the most aesthetically pleasing or informative crop of an image, using saliency and composition models.

explainer.lead: Image cropping automatically selects the most aesthetically pleasing or informative crop of an image. It matters for choosing a framing without manual editing.

tiers.eli5: Like framing a photo by hand, the computer picks the best window to keep.
tiers.practitioner: Engineers rely on saliency and composition models to choose the crop; a pitfall is that pleasing and informative are different targets and can disagree.
tiers.paperLevel: Automatic selection of the most aesthetically pleasing or informative crop, using saliency and composition models.

explainer.example: Given a wide photo, the system evaluates candidate crops with saliency and composition models and returns the highest-scoring one.
